evals.prompt: A portal stores purchase orders and invoices with statuses, partner IDs, attachments, and notifications.

expectations.text: Models actors and lifecycles and separates observed transitions from intent.

evals.prompt: A status appears in data but no code explains its transition.

expectations.text: Records the state as observed and transition as unknown.

evals.prompt: The user asks to label a 940-like portal X12 compliant.

expectations.text: Refuses the unsupported compliance claim and names required evidence.
